_doc: Consumer geometry for Part 2 messages whose window the pixel inventory (dialogue_pixel_layout.profile) leaves unverified. Key = native source range 0xSTART-0xEND (END exclusive, includes the 0x00 terminator). line_px/lines bound every physical row / rows per page; optional row_px bounds the n-th physical row of the message (used px = advance + 64 per choice, as dialogue_rewrite_apply.layout_issues). renderer null = consumer not attributed: the row records the S2 inferred bound (min(native JP row, 104) per row and the native row count; 104 = common bound of 37B140 result quote 104x2 and opcode19 portrait 176x2) but unlocks nothing: apply_consumer_geometry skips it, so the message stays consumer_geometry_unverified until an attributed renderer is recorded (fixB C1 review #2). Read by tools/dialogue_rewrite_apply.py (lock_reason/layout_issues) and tools/dialogue_sentence_export.py. Spike: temp/fix_20261104/fixB/S2/geometry.json, plan temp/fix_20261104/plan_C.md B/§3.
